use_case_changes.note: Proposed only; the use_case record was not edited. No exclusion or scope change is proposed.

summary_proposal.value: Two new comparisons test computational evidence against BRCA1 and BRCA2 functional assay classes, which stand in for clinical classification; neither measures complete classifications or reviewer errors. Cubuk et al. 2021 scored 44 tools at 70 published thresholds and 14 concordance combinations. Against 1,641 BRCA1 variants classed by saturation genome editing, no single binary call was strong in both directions: REVEL above 0.7 gave a positive likelihood ratio of 4.54 but called 72 of 371 deleterious variants tolerated, while REVEL above 0.5 missed 3 and gave a likelihood ratio for benignity of 22.4 with a positive likelihood ratio of only 1.21. BayesDel at the thresholds used there followed the second pattern (2 of 371 missed; positive likelihood ratio 1.09). The BRCA2 set has only 64 deleterious variants and 25 of 84 rows have no false negatives, so its benignity ratios rest on a zero-cell correction. The printed intervals for the benignity ratios do not match the counts and are not used. Ramadane-Morchadi et al. 2025 compared AlphaMissense, FoldX ΔΔG and BayesDel at three-category PP3/BP4 thresholds on 1,519 BRCA1 variants from the same assay. All reached moderate to strong evidence (log2 likelihood ratio +2.1 to +3.0 for PP3, -2.3 to -4.6 for BP4). AlphaMissense at 0.65 and 0.75 left 5% of variants without a code, against 14% for the VCEP BayesDel thresholds, at similar strength. At the PP3 cut, sensitivity ranged from 74.2% (ΔΔG on PDB structures, 2.5) to 89.1% (ΔΔG on AlphaFold2 models, 3), with AlphaMissense 84.3% and BayesDel 79.8%. The AlphaMissense and ΔΔG thresholds were chosen on the same variants, three authors are Ambry Genetics employees, and the same functional data underlie the existing ENIGMA BayesDel calibration.
summary_proposal.note: Covers the new judgements only. The integrator should merge it with any existing summary for this use case.

concerns_for_reviewer.locator: Supplementary Table 9, BRCA1_negative_LR and BRCA2_negative_LR columns (G2:G85, I2:I85), against Supplementary Table 6 counts
concerns_for_reviewer.message: In all 168 BRCA1/BRCA2 cells the printed 'negative likelihood ratio' interval has the same log-scale width as the positive likelihood ratio interval in the same row. The positive intervals match a 95% log-method interval from the Table 6 counts; the negative ones are far narrower than the counts allow (for example BayesDEL_NoMaxAF_genespecific BRCA1 prints 10.8 (10.4-11.1) from 7 false negatives; a log-method interval is about 5.1 to 22.7). Point values agree with the counts. The intervals are kept in printed_source_cell and marked uncertainty 'conflicting'. The reviewer may prefer a source evidence_concern, which would withhold both Cubuk judgements.

concerns_for_reviewer.locator: Supplementary_Materials row 10 (Table 9 note) and the 62 likelihood-ratio results with source_anomaly
concerns_for_reviewer.message: The sheet note says cells are blank where a count is zero, but values are printed for all 31 gene-tool rows with a zero count. They match 0.5 added to every count (Haldane correction), which the Methods mention only for Tables 10 and 11. Marked on each affected result.

concerns_for_reviewer.locator: Table 2, 'ΔΔG AF a' group, row '≥+3', column 'NPV'
concerns_for_reviewer.message: NPV 96.6 is printed with interval 92.3-97.5, 4.3 below and 0.9 above; every other interval in the table is within a ratio of 1.5. The lower bound may be misprinted (about 95.3 would be expected for roughly 1,050 predicted-negative variants). Recorded as printed with source_anomaly.

Three authors are Ambry Genetics employees and several are ENIGMA BRCA1/2 VCEP contributors. Recorded in protocol limitations; origin kept as independent_paper because no author developed AlphaMissense, FoldX or BayesDel.

Cubuk's 'gene-specific' BayesDel thresholds (BRCA1 0.074 or -0.07; BRCA2 -0.11 or -0.34) are their own cut-offs, not the BRCA1/2 VCEP thresholds (0.28 and 0.15) used in the existing ENIGMA judgements and in Ramadane-Morchadi. The rows should not be read as tests of the VCEP specification.

gaps: No source compares complete classifications, serious misclassification counts adjudicated by experts, or reviewer time; both sources use functional class as truth.
No BRCA2 saturation genome editing truth set (Huang et al. 2025) was used; the BRCA2 evidence rests on 188 DNA-binding-domain variants.
SpliceAI and other splicing predictors are not covered; both sources are missense only.
Cubuk Supplementary Tables 8 (sensitivity, specificity, AUC), 10 and 11 (REVEL and Meta-SNP score bands) and 13 were not extracted.
Ramadane-Morchadi Table S1 (variant-level scores) and the domain and RSA stratifications (Table S4, Figures S9-S11) were not extracted.
